topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe this. Right there, on some dingy table, covered in a layer of dust and memories I’d rather forget, my old teddy bear stares back at me with those glassy eyes. I swear, if I hadn’t recognized the faded red bow around its neck, I’d have walked right past it. What is it doing here? Did Mom finally give up and throw out everything I left behind? I clench my fists, my nails digging into my palms. I grab the bear, stuffing it into my jacket, and toss a few crumpled bills on the table. I’m out of here.
